g0.tap: identical shape, dtype and same-width unsigned bytes
g0.archive_tolerance_basis: Voice BP1 registration specifies 1e-4 relative L2 for the waveform. Div_2 has a recorded max error but no independently registered bar. Use the published relative L2 bar for the requested Div_2 cross-check and report max absolute error separately. Compare the corresponding archived slice on the crop and disclose its full-row normalization and convolution context.

g1.rationale: The 128 style components aggregate factored fp32 AdaIN contributions across the full decoder and generator. The 1e-4 bar allows deep-chain rounding and reduction-order differences against fp64. Individual parameter gradients include reductions over up to 4801 crop positions, shared initializer fan-in, and different convolution packing and reduction trees. The 1e-3 bar allows their accumulated rounding. At a reference norm strictly below 1e-6 of the largest parameter gradient, relative L2 is ill-conditioned and absolute L2 is capped at that same global scale. Every test is two-sided.

g2.step: cbrt(float64 eps) * max(1, abs(entry) or L2(style)); permitted deterministic halvings only to avoid LeakyReLU crossings
g2.rationale: Use DESIGN section 6 central differences and plateau bound against the fp64 directional VJP. Also compare each candidate projection to each fp64 central difference under the same bound. Scale G by 1/sqrt(boundary size), fixed per shape. Verify LeakyReLU sign masks at every endpoint and at the center. Unresolved probes fail.

g3_g4: identical shape, dtype and same-width unsigned bytes, for style and every parameter

g5.rationale: Order bar in decimal bytes. DESIGN section 5 predicts 2.7–3.3 GB live checkpointed and 8.7–9.1 GB uncheckpointed. Record device pool peaks with raw usage accounting, as well as synchronized wall and backward times.

seed.distribution: standard_normal in fp64, divided by sqrt(tensor size) then stored in fp32 and converted to fp64 for the oracle

array_checks: Each compared array is finite and nonempty, with more than one distinct value where it contains more than one element. Scalar observations must be nonzero.
